coverage: Read the complete available local article body; linked images, videos and external claims not independently inspected.
basis: Practitioner account / proposed exercise; no direct causal evaluation of the extracted practice.
reported_outcomes: Uses a fictional onboarding game to illustrate questions.
limits: Fiction is not a test of named vendors. Blanket surveillance claims not established. The chatbot cannot certify actual telemetry or policy. Unknown answers do not establish malicious intent.
review_note: Ask what a workplace tool collects, who can access it, where it goes and how it affects assessment.
author: Sam Illingworth
